results.name: rice cooker
results.description: Electric cooker, also known as electric cooker, electric cooker. It is a cooker that uses electric energy to convert into heat energy. It has many kinds of operation functions such as steaming, boiling, stewing, stewing and so on. It is convenient to use, safe and reliable. It can not only cook the food, but also keep it warm. It is clean, pollution-free, time-saving and labor-saving. It is one of the indispensable appliances for the modernization of housework. During the Second World War, the common rice cookers were divided into three types: automatic heat preservation type, timing heat preservation type and new type of microcomputer control type.
